cover.headline: 5 hook formulas that work in every niche.

slides.title: "I tried / quit / lost..."
slides.body: Personal stakes. People stay to see what happened to you.

slides.title: "Most people don't know..."
slides.body: Curiosity gap. Implies you have the inside answer.

slides.title: "If you're [X], stop doing [Y]."
slides.body: Calls out a specific person. They can't scroll past themselves.

slides.title: "Here's the truth about [X]."
slides.body: Positions you as the one cutting through the noise.

slides.title: "[Number] things I learned about [X]."
slides.body: Promises a list. The brain wants to finish what it starts.

caption:
5 hook formulas that work in every niche I edit for.

1. "I tried / quit / lost..."
2. "Most people don't know..."
3. "If you're [X], stop doing [Y]."
4. "Here's the truth about [X]."
5. "[Number] things I learned about [X]."

cover.headline: 7 things I check before every shoot.

slides.title: 1. 4K at 60fps
slides.body: The only camera setting that actually matters. Set it once.

slides.title: 2. Mic test + playback
slides.body: Record 5 seconds and listen back. Don't trust the levels alone.

slides.title: 3. Hooks pre-written
slides.body: 1.5 seconds, memorized. Never wing the first line.

slides.title: 4. 8 hook locations scouted
slides.body: Switch spot every line. This is the one everyone skips.

slides.title: 5. Batteries + storage
slides.body: Two of everything. A dead battery ends the day.

slides.title: 6. Backup phone
slides.body: One device failure shouldn't cancel a client shoot.

slides.title: 7. Frame for the title
slides.body: Leave space above the head so the overlay never covers your face.

caption:
I never start a shoot without running this list. Number 4 is the one most people skip — and it's why their talking-head videos feel flat.

alt_text: Carousel: 7 things I check before every shoot.

slides.title: 1. Captions too small
slides.body: If it's hard to read on a phone, it's costing you watch time.

slides.title: 2. Off the beat
slides.body: Text should hit on the cut, not lag behind the sentence.

slides.title: 3. Buried at the bottom
slides.body: The UI covers it. Keep key words in the safe zone.

slides.title: 4. Wrong font
slides.body: Use white, modern, sans-serif. No heavy drop shadows.

slides.title: 5. One word at a time, too slow
slides.body: Pace the captions to feel faster than the video really is.

caption:
Captions aren't decoration. They're a retention tool — and these 5 mistakes quietly leak your views.

1. Too small
2. Off the beat
3. Buried at the bottom
4. Wrong font
5. Paced too slow

slides.title: Act 1 — The hook (0 to 1.5s)
slides.body: State the problem sharp. No intro, no setup. Stop the thumb.

slides.title: Act 2 — The tension (4 to 12s)
slides.body: Build the gap. Give a reason to keep watching past second 4.

slides.title: Act 3 — The payoff (13s to end)
slides.body: Deliver the answer, then one clear CTA. Don't trail off.

slides.title: Why most fail
slides.body: They film all hook, or all payoff. The tension in the middle is what holds people.

caption:
Every short-form video that pops has 3 acts. Most people only film one and wonder why retention dies.

Act 1: Hook (0–1.5s)
Act 2: Tension (4–12s)
Act 3: Payoff (13s+)

cover.headline: Why clients fire agencies in month 3.
cover.subheadline: And how to make sure they don't.

slides.title: Month 1 — Honeymoon
slides.body: Everyone's excited. Content's flowing. Nobody's checking results yet.

slides.title: Month 2 — "Where's my ROI?"
slides.body: The questions start. Expectations and reality drift apart.

slides.title: Month 3 — Panic fire
slides.body: No leads visible, so they cut. Even if the work was good.

slides.title: The fix
slides.body: Set leading-indicator goals (views, saves, DMs) BEFORE month 1 starts. Manage the timeline, not just the work.

caption:
Most clients fire video agencies in month 3 — and it's almost always the same arc.

Month 1: honeymoon
Month 2: "where's my ROI?"
Month 3: panic fire

The fix is expectation-setting before you ever start. Manage the timeline, not just the output.

cover.headline: 5 rules behind every video we ship.

slides.title: 1. iPhone 4K at 60fps
slides.body: You don't need a cinema camera. You need the right settings.

slides.title: 2. 1.5-second hook, pre-written
slides.body: Memorized before the camera turns on. Never improvised.

slides.title: 3. Switch location every line
slides.body: Two lines in the same spot? Move. Movement reads as energy.

slides.title: 4. One specific number per video
slides.body: Clients, hours, views, MRR. Specifics build trust.

slides.title: 5. Music quieter than feels right
slides.body: Trim ruthlessly. The voice leads, the music supports.

caption:
5 rules behind every video we put out. None of them need expensive gear — they need discipline.

1. iPhone 4K/60fps
2. 1.5s hook, pre-written
3. Switch location every line
4. One specific number per video
5. Music quieter than feels right
